Exercise A

Mixed practice

This is optional practice for the whole week. Choose the correct form for each gap, then press Check.

Before you start — optional, not marked
This is just to get you thinking. You can leave it empty and it does not count towards your score.

Exercise B

Arrange a study session

You and a classmate want to revise together before the January exams. Write a message to arrange it.

Word count: 0

Suggest two times, mention one fixed arrangement you already have (I’m meeting…), and say what you will have finished by then (By Friday I’ll have…). Write 60–80 words.
